twoFactor.title: Sign-in code
twoFactor.intro: To protect your account, a 6-digit code has just been sent to {{email}}. Enter it to finish signing in.
twoFactor.validity: The code is valid for {{minutes}} minutes. Check your spam folder too.
twoFactor.resent: A new code has been sent to {{email}}.
twoFactor.codeFormat: Enter the 6 digits of the code received by email.
twoFactor.network: The server is not responding. Check your internet connection and try again.
twoFactor.throttled: Too many attempts. Wait a minute before trying again.
twoFactor.expired: This sign-in attempt has expired. Sign in again with your password.

admin.title: Two-factor authentication — {{company}}
admin.intro: When enabled, everyone in the company receives a code by email after their password. The super admin is not affected.
admin.notReady: Email sending is not configured on this server: two-factor authentication cannot be enabled until it is.
admin.missing: {{count}} account(s) without a real email address: they won't be able to sign in until an address is entered.
admin.allSet: Every account has a real email address.
admin.name: Name
admin.loadFailed: Could not load the company's accounts. Try again.
admin.emailInvalid: "{{email}}" is not a valid email address.
admin.loginHint: The person can then sign in with their login or with this address.

twoFactor.devCode: Development phase: you can also enter this code.
